title: Giant skeletons dug up in excavations of monumental earthworks

tellings.quote: The excavations particularly associated with the monumental earthworks giant skeletons. Those accounts are repeated over and over and over again that in the excavation there's a giant skeleton dug up sometimes seven feet sometimes eight sometimes even nine feet in height.

plain: The researcher Randall Carlson says that old accounts of digs into the great ancient earth mounds of the United States describe, over and over, giant human skeletons seven, eight and sometimes nine feet tall. He summarises this without naming a single source, pointing broadly to 19th-century archives, the records of the Bureau of American Ethnology, a US government office that studied Native American peoples, and early papers of the Smithsonian, the national museum, and he mentions the writer Graham Hancock. If true, it would suggest a lost chapter of the continent's ancient past.
